message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, later by General Vasily Trofimov).
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Kaiser, later General Fedor von Bock).
• **Axis Allies** – Italian, Romanian, Hungarian, and German auxiliary units supported the German effort. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, on the western bank of the **Volga River**. The battle took place in and around the urban center, with fighting extending into the surrounding countryside and the Volga’s strategic crossings. | The battle is widely regarded as the turning point of the Eastern Front, where the Soviet forces encircled and ultimately defeated the German 6th Army, marking the beginning of a decisive Soviet counter‑offensive.
